ESSENCE: [0] Light-nature entails awareness-nature: specified twofold and three-functioned as unmade-I flashing, the calm-brahman alternative refused, absence entailing lordlessness and deadness.

paragraphs.text: If something is made of light, then it must also be made of awareness — you cannot have one without the other. Awareness comes in two sizes, bounded and boundless, and it works three jobs: making, keeping, and withdrawing. Each job is just the flash of an I that was never put together by anyone. The rival idea — a calm, blank knowing with nothing in it — is refused. And take awareness away, and two things follow: no lordship, and deadness.
